selection_criteria.primary_criterion: Screening Sensitivity / Recall for positive class (Malignant)
selection_criteria.error_analysis_criterion: Minimization of False Negatives (missed malignant screening estimates)
selection_criteria.parsimony_criterion: Model simplicity, interpretability, and smooth probability calibration

selection_rationale: Selected based strictly on Step 6 5-fold cross-validation evidence on the training partition: Logistic Regression achieved the highest mean ROC-AUC (0.9958 ± 0.0047), the highest mean F1-score (0.9640 ± 0.0207), the highest mean Precision (0.9771 ± 0.0280), and tied for the highest Recall (0.9529 ± 0.0399) with the fewest total False Negatives (8 out of 170 malignant cases). Furthermore, as an L2-regularized linear model, it is mathematically parsimonious, robust against overfitting on small continuous tabular datasets, and provides smooth, native probability calibration via the sigmoid link.
disclaimer: This model provides an AI-based risk screening estimate and does not constitute a definitive medical diagnosis.
